claims.text: A 20-year-old nulliparous professional bowler presented with lower abdominal pain and had no notable past medical, surgical or family history. Examination showed a soft, non-tender abdomen and a mobile, enlarged lower abdominal mass. Ultrasonography and MRI showed a unilocular cyst of the left ovary; CA 19-9 was mildly elevated and other tumor markers were within normal ranges.
